column3: Kuroneko Route · God's Trial
...Why aren't you saying anything?
Don't tell me you plan on staying silent...
Am I someone whose existence is trivial to you?
...I just don't know how to phrase it. It's not that you aren't important or anything.
So that's what my existence is to you.
Someone about whom you can't find an answer. That's about it.
...N-Nothing of that sort.
If so, why can't you come up with an answer?
T-That's...
How could you be trivial to me...
...Hmph. Whatever you say.
Forget it, even if you're just saying it to humor me... I'm a bit happy.
Is that so...
...However, if that's the case, why are you remaining silent?
That's because I don't know how to say it.
Oh really. So you've stumbled onto this situation when you're unable to give an answer.
You truly are a helpless nice guy...
Never thinking about yourself, always jumping into action... That's why you always barge in without first considering what others might think or what
kind of situation they are in.
You even try to meddle with things that are beyond your ability.
...True, I haven't considered it before... I'm just thinking that being hardworking will certainly bring us somewhere...
Kuh...
......Heh. Seems like I've hit the bulls-eye.
It's not over yet, is it? There must still be something we could do?
Isn't it still too early to be giving up? Why can you say that so easily?
...It is as you say. As long as we don't give up, there must be a way. People often say that.
Right?
Though that's the babbling of an ignorant person who doesn't understand anything about the situation...
That is... Certainly, I'm not as knowledgeable as you...
However, for that reason let me say this. As long as we don't lose hope, we'll manage somehow!
Good grief... I really need to learn a little from your unyielding motivation.
However...
Even so, a schedule like this is impossible from the start.
It was very strict from the start, yet a novice like you wants to join in...
It seems to be that way. Whichever wicked gods there be, they are all calling me to give up.
...It's not impossible. There's still something we can do, right?
What else can we do? Try saying it?
L-Like I said, I'll pay for--
...And I'm telling you that's a nuisance.
It's a dead end. We don't have any solution. We're like rats driven into a corner.
There's a saying that goes 'A cornered rat will bite the cat'. Even if it's us...
We're different from a rat... It is useless to struggle any further.
H-How could you put it that way...
Because that's the truth? There's no other solution...
I'm sure deep down in your heart you have already given up, right?
...That's not how I feel.
Right. I was certain you would say that.
However, I don't need that. I don't care if your meddling is out of good will or kindness, I don't need any of that.
...Damn. Isn't there something I could do?
......No good. I can't think of anything I could do...
...Damn it.
That's right. Even we can't rise from the verge of death anymore.
It's a pity... A Bad End.
Sometimes, peoples' good will can backfire. That's exactly what happened here.
...What did I do to make it backfire...?
I told you, didn't I? This is my creation, if I'm not happy with it, there's no meaning in doing it.
I don't want to continue if I must receive other people's charity.
...Charity...? I didn't mean something like that...
But in the end it became that way.
Y-You're wrong.
It doesn't matter what your intentions were, the situation is as such. I'm not able to do anything and you want to solve that, obviously.
But, my pride won't allow something like that.
I'm really grateful for your help. However...
This game of make-believe is hereby over.
...What's with that?
Don't ask for returns if we are to maintain good relations. What's the difference between this and a child's game of make-believe?
Why are you being so masochistic?
...The one unable to answer was you, wasn't it?
That...
That's why, the thing that binds us is no more.
Hmph... To be more specific, isn't this the same as acting as siblings?
This girl... is she still worrying about that?
No, that's not right... She is just giving herself up to despair...
...It's just a little further until we're done, right? Think about it again...
That's not what you're thinking for real too, right? It seems like you're just hurting yourself...
Acting...? What's with that?
But isn't that the case?
It isn't! I told you it's not that way. You can't let this incident make you lose sight of yourself!
Let's just end this already.
End it... end what?
............Everything.
All the manuscript work we were doing up until now, and also this fake-drama...
What's with that!? Was that the extent of your passion?
Was this something so cheap to let it slide using the word 'drama'?
And yet you call it fake!? Was everything you were doing up until now all fake!?
It's something yours, and yours alone, right? You called it your own work, right!?
Isn't this one of those production hardships you had to go through!?
Do I seem hurt? I'm just merely stating a fact.
If we're not acting like siblings, then I guess we're imitating friendship? It sounds like a childish youth TV drama...?
...No... It's not that, you know? You need to calm down a little. Stop joking about this.
...Hehe. That's right... Indeed, it was just nonsense just now.
...However, this trouble is all reality.
...But if you don't give up, you can still manage somehow, isn't that right?
...That's right. That's my desire... But there are situations that you just can't do anything about.
...Urgh, enough! When someone is trying to say something constructive, you shut it down immediately!
You're just my kouhai, so don't get cocky. Just be quiet and accept your senpai's good-will.
Heh... Now you can't even form decent words, what is it now? You're getting angry at me?
It's true those words are ones which describes our relationship... But, you won't say that you got involved with me because of those kind of words?
My only kouhai is you alone.
You're too noisy! Wake up and listen to me!
No. It's all pointless to continue any further.
You're my important kouhai!
Heh. Senpai and kouhai? Aren't I just one of the many kouhai that you have?
That's not true! You're my only kouhai!
This has got nothing to do with other people! I'm really worried about you, troubled over your problems, meddling with your issues, all just to see
you smile!
That's right, at most, the tablet broke. But it is a problem which I as a high-school student can't solve.
I don't have the money, it's absurd to borrow from other people.... It's fatal. I can't do anything at all. It's checkmate.
Fatal, you say....
There's no way around it.
What are you talking about as if you know everything? Hear what your senpai has to say to you sometimes.
Hmph... You can't even say decent things now, so you're appealing from that position?
It's true that those words are the ones which describes our relationship... But, you won't say that you got involved with me because of those kind of
words?
My only kouhai is you alone!
Wha... Y-You have a lot of other kouhai, don't you?
Yeah, that's right. But the only important kouhai for me is you alone.
